title: Orientation Day
description: Welcome event for new members: club tour, team games and a short talk about what the club does during the year.

title: Welcome Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop on study planning and note-taking, run by senior members.

title: Study Camp
description: Three-day overnight camp with tutoring sessions, group projects and evening activities before mid-term exams.

title: Charity Run
description: A 5 km fun run that raised funds for a school library. Includes registration, water stations and prizes.

title: Career Talk
description: Alumni speakers share how they found their first job and answer questions from members.

title: Board Game Night
description: Casual evening of board games. Cancelled because the venue was no longer available.

title: Photography Walk
description: Guided photo walk through the old town with a mini photo contest at the end.

title: Mid-term Review Session
description: Five days of review sessions for mid-term exams, one subject per day, led by volunteer tutors.

title: Year-End Party
description: Celebration for all members with food, performances and awards for the year.
